scope: Read-only reconciliation of frozen P1i valid-only Table B evidence; no inference or checkpoint changes

governance.historical_test_iid_status: documented historical and visualization-only access; not an untouched split

frozen_evidence.heat3d_layout: flat canonical x_y_z sidecar; posthoc immutable sidecar binding, not re-inferred
frozen_evidence.thermfm_layout: z_x_y source layout transposed once to canonical evaluator x_y_z

metric_definitions.peak_temperature_mae_K: mean of the per-sample scalar peak absolute errors
metric_definitions.peak_temperature_rmse_K: sqrt(mean of squared per-sample scalar peak absolute errors))
metric_definitions.true_hotspot_region_rmse_K: field RMSE restricted to the top 1% (2409) nodes ranked by T_true within each sample
metric_definitions.true_hotspot_top1_overlap_pct: predicted-vs-true top-1% hotspot localization overlap; auxiliary localization diagnostic
metric_definitions.dispersion: mean ± SD across training seeds; not case or seed×case independent-sample SD

final_table_b_conclusion.thermfm: lower sample-first relative RMSE, MAE, and true-hotspot-region RMSE on the frozen valid cohort
final_table_b_conclusion.heat3d: slightly lower scalar peak error, higher Corr_point/Corr_CV and higher true-hotspot top-1% overlap
final_table_b_conclusion.ci: point-global/RMSE differences and peak-error differences have paired case-bootstrap intervals crossing zero; sample-first/MAE/hotspot intervals favor Therm-FM descriptively under the frozen cohort
final_table_b_conclusion.claim_boundary: no overall winner and no same-information-budget claim

superseded_wording.old_wording: true-hotspot top-1% overlap and the raw peak RMSE
superseded_wording.reason: peak metric was not explicitly separated from hotspot-region field error or localization overlap
superseded_wording.replacement: peak MAE/RMSE are scalar max-temperature errors; hotspot RMSE is truth-top-1% field error; top-1% overlap is localization

superseded_wording.reason: could be read as equating scalar peak accuracy with hotspot-region accuracy
superseded_wording.replacement: all final claims use the explicit metric definitions above; no direct numerical conflation was found in the frozen Table B values

historical_bridge.role: appendix-only explanation of evidence evolution; not a re-ranking
